content: Our proposed method belongs to the transfer learning, but it is different from traditional transfer methods which train a parent model as starting point. Before training a parent model, our approach fully leverages cross-lingual pre-training methods to make all source languages share the same feature space and thus enables a smooth transition for zero-shot translation.
